quality control.

sections.text: Check the direction of rotation of pump and driver.

Check the oil level in gearbox or fill it to the maximum 
 height with the recommended grade of lubricating oil.

Check that the mechanical seal circulation pipe (if fitted) 
 is clear and not blocked.

Check that if the suction and discharge pipes have been 
 secured to the pump no strain has been imposed it must be possible to turn 
 the coupling by hand without feeling tight spot.

Check that suction pipe flange joint is air light the 
 entrainment of air must be avoided.
Check the temperature of bearing houses.
Check any noise or vibration in pump.
Check any leakage from the piping connection to the pump.
Check the pressure in the pump delivery.
تحقق من المحاذاة بين المضخة والمحرك.
Retighten all bolts connected pump and motor with foundation.

Return back all mechanical and electrical pump positions to the normal by 
 coordinating with shift engineer
Operate the pump and ensure that it is OK and record the readings.
